[[File:Jango_Fett_blasters.png|thumb|250px|A pair of WESTAR-34 blaster pistol with dallorian alloy plating.]]

'''Dallorian alloy''' was a hard alloy that was naturally resistant to heat, making it popular among companies and corporations who [[Mining/Legends|mined]] minerals and metals. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] custom-made [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|WESTAR-34 blaster pistols]] had dallorian alloy plating, keeping them from overheating in a fast-paced battle. It was also used in the creation of certain segments of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] first suit of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]]. [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]’s personalized [[LL-30 blaster pistol/Legends|LL-30 blaster pistols]] —nicknamed his "Persuaders," were also made out of dallorian alloy that prevented overheating during prolonged usage.<ref name="Duel at Shattered Rock">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''</ref>
